context: Evaluate native Cursor export and optional hook instrumentation using source-backed signal, accounting, and correlation boundaries.

checklist.name: Native configuration and signal boundary
checklist.description: Uses official Cursor sources, Enterprise team-managed export, HTTPS OTLP/HTTP protobuf and metrics/logs pipelines. Does not invent native traces, desktop exporter settings, or gRPC support.

checklist.name: Usage accounting and delivery
checklist.description: Uses documented metric names and delta semantics; treats cost as an estimate with BYOK limits. Accounts for metric loss and log duplication, deduplication identity, and billing corrections rather than asserting complete invoice reconciliation. Preserves complete series identity and handles overlapping delta windows; does not assume a Prometheus scrape exporter or untested conversion gives correct totals.

checklist.name: Meaningful optional hooks
checklist.description: Explains callback-derived execution traces versus native usage. Distinguishes hook-script duration from tool duration. Does not require community software or promise hidden model-call coverage.

checklist.name: Correlation without duplicate accounting
checklist.description: Proposes validating conversation-ID mapping between sources, retains provenance, and avoids double-counting. Does not manufacture native trace context or use session IDs as metric dimensions.

checklist.name: Surface, privacy, and received-data validation
checklist.description: Checks desktop/CLI/cloud callback differences and installed adapter version. Keeps native conversation export and community payload capture disabled independently; verifies representative received signals, failures, and content absence. Does not present local unpublished changes or configuration alone as live coverage. Separates export families, conversation capture and bot Action Recording; missing user fields and scrubbed command/URL content still require inspection.
